tail: Let there arise salvation from heaven, mercy and kindness, long life, abundant food, divine help, bodily health, heavenly enlightenment, living and enduring seed, who do not interrupt or abandon study of the words of the Torah, to this holy congregation, old and young, children and women. May the King of the world bless you, prolong your life, increase your days and give length to your years. May you be saved and delivered from every need and all evil happenings. May our Lord in heaven aid you at every time and season, and let us say: Amen.
